front.title: Template-Driven HTTP CONNECT Proxying for TCP

abstract.t: TCP tunneling using HTTP CONNECT has long been part of the core HTTP specification. However, this tunneling functionality has several important deficiencies due to the lack of a well-defined HTTP origin or path. This specification remedies those deficiencies by defining CONNECT-TCP, an alternative protocol for tunneling TCP in HTTP. A proxy service for this protocol is described by a URI Template, similar to the CONNECT-UDP and CONNECT-IP protocols.
